# QC12: 澄心堂 Chengxin Tang

Wave 4 · Qichun Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=QC12` · Page: `/scenes/#QC12` · Row: `research/buildings/QC12-chengxin-tang/`

## What it was

澄心堂 Chengxin Tang, on an island in the south lake of the western group of Qichun Yuan, once the waste plot 竹园: rebuilt about 1815 as a five-bay hall in two rolls with a hip-gable annex and side wings, stone-edged banks and bridges, with plaques 垂虹榭 and 绮旭轩 (E0696, E0698). Xianfeng served the dowager consort a meal here in 1852 (E0697).

From the inventory row: **built** 嘉庆十九年 1814; 1815 rebuilt; **destroyed** 1860 (S06, S49, S01, S220, S361).
